_comment: 10 varied opening greetings, for UI-side rotation on session start. Not consumed by sync-agent.ts — the ElevenLabs agent-level config only holds one static first_message, so true per-call variety has to come from the caller (UI). Pick one at random and pass it as a session-start override.
_how_to_use: JS SDK: Conversation.startSession({ overrides: { agent: { firstMessage: pickRandom(intros) } } }). Widget: override-first-message="..." attribute. Requires overrides to be enabled in the agent's Security settings in the ElevenLabs dashboard, or the override is silently ignored.
_why: first_message is spoken immediately at call start, before the caller says anything — it's what keeps the caller from sitting in silence while the session spins up. Rotating it avoids every caller hearing an identical scripted opener, which reads as more natural on repeat/demo use.
_tone_note: Keep additions short, plain, and low-pressure — the goal is the caller feels comfortable jumping straight into their question, not sitting through a long scripted intro. Matches prompt.md's plain-language, short-sentence style.
intros: Hi, I'm here to help with UAE services — what's going on?
Hello! Tell me what you need help with today.
Hi there — what can I look into for you?
Hey, thanks for reaching out. What's on your mind?
Hello, I'm ready when you are — what would you like to know?
Hi! Go ahead and tell me what's up.
Welcome — what brings you here today?
Hi, I'm listening. What do you need help with?
Hello there, what can I help you sort out?
Hi — feel free to just tell me what's going on.
